mapper.select: SELECT result_tb.* FROM(SELECT (SELECT auth_name FROM CBCI_AUTH ca WHERE ca.auth_type = cu.USER_TYPE AND auth_division = 'user') as auth_name, DATE_FORMAT(IF(cu.USER_TYPE = 02, (SELECT MAX(mb_approval_date) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE user_code = cu.USER_CODE), cu.REG_DATE),'%Y-%m-%d') as reg_date, (SELECT mbid FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur WHERE mur.user_code = cu.user_code group by cu.reg_date) AS mbid, cu.user_id, cu.user_nm, cu.firm_nm, IFNULL((cu.user_phone),'-') AS user_phone, IFNULL((cu.firm_tel),'-') AS firm_tel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT ca WHERE ca.USER_CODE = cu.USER_CODE) AS shop_count, cu.firm_addr, cu.user_type, cu.user_code FROM CBCI_USER cu WHERE cu.user_nm like concat('%', #{NKeyword},'%') AND cu.firm_nm like concat('%', #{CKeyword},'%') AND cu.user_id like concat('%', #{IdKeyword},'%') AND cu.user_type like concat('%', #{useService} ,'%')) result_tb WHERE result_tb.reg_date >= #{fromDate} AND result_tb.reg_date <= #{toDate} ORDER BY result_tb.auth_name LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(result_tb.user_id) as total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN result_tb.user_type IN ('01') THEN 1 END) as cubici_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN result_tb.user_type IN ('02') THEN 1 END) as mb_count FROM(SELECT (SELECT auth_name FROM CBCI_AUTH ca WHERE ca.auth_type = cu.USER_TYPE AND auth_division = 'user') as auth_name, DATE_FORMAT(IF(cu.USER_TYPE = 02, (SELECT MAX(mb_approval_date) FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE user_code = cu.USER_CODE), cu.REG_DATE),'%Y-%m-%d') as reg_date, (SELECT mbid FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur WHERE mur.user_code = cu.user_code group by cu.reg_date) AS mbid, cu.user_id, cu.user_nm, cu.firm_nm, IFNULL((cu.user_phone),'-') AS user_phone, IFNULL((cu.firm_tel),'-') AS firm_tel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT ca WHERE ca.USER_CODE = cu.USER_CODE) AS shop_count, cu.firm_addr, cu.user_type, cu.user_code FROM CBCI_USER cu WHERE cu.user_nm like concat('%', #{NKeyword},'%') AND cu.firm_nm like concat('%', #{CKeyword},'%') AND cu.user_id like concat('%', #{IdKeyword},'%') AND cu.user_type like concat('%', #{useService} ,'%')) result_tb WHERE result_tb.reg_date >= #{fromDate} AND result_tb.reg_date <= #{toDate}

SELECT cu.USER_CODE , (SELECT auth_name FROM CBCI_AUTH WHERE auth_type = user_type AND auth_division = 'user') AS status , cu.user_nm , cu.user_id , DATE_FORMAT(cu.reg_date , '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_date , cu.firm_nm , cu.firm_id , (SELECT select_nm FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE select_cd = business_type AND select_class = 'biztype') AS biz_type , (SELECT select_nm FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE select_cd = business_type AND select_class = 'CBCI_SECTOR') AS sector , DATE_FORMAT(cu.firm_setup_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS firm_setup_date , cu.user_phone , cu.firm_zip_code , cu.firm_addr , mur.mbid , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE "" END AS mb_product_code , MAX(IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date,'%y-%m-%d'), '-')) AS mb_contract_expire_date , mur.mb_demand_acc_number AS demand_acc , mur.mb_main_acc_number AS main_acc , (SELECT bank_name FROM CBCI_BANK_CODE cbc WHERE bank_code = mur.mb_main_acc_bank_code) as main_bank_name , (SELECT bank_name FROM CBCI_BANK_CODE cbc WHERE bank_code = mur.mb_demand_acc_bank_code ) as demand_bank_name FROM CBCI_USER cu LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur ON cu.USER_CODE = mur.user_code WHERE cu.user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT cbc.charge_name as charge_name, DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as expire_date, FORMAT(cbpd.amount, 0) as amount, IFNULL(cpc.promo_name, '') as promo_name, IFNULL(cp.partner_nm, '') as partner_nm FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc ON cbpd.charge_code = cbc.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc ON cbpd.promotion_code = cpc.promo_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_PARTNER cp ON cp.partner_code = cpc.partner_code WHERE user_code = #{value} ORDER BY cbpd.start_date desc LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(total_day) + SUM(IF(charge_type = 'F', -total_day, -excep_day)) as effective_count FROM( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(day, start_date, next_start_date) as total_day, IF(next_start_date < expire_date, 0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(day, expire_date, next_start_date)) AS excep_day, charge_type FROM( SELECT IFNULL(lead(start_date) over(ORDER BY start_date), expire_date) as next_start_date, fv_tb.* FROM( SELECT IF(now() >= cbpd.start_date, cbpd.start_date, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')) as start_date, IF(now() >= IFNULL(cancel_date, cbpd.expire_date), IFNULL(cancel_date, cbpd.expire_date) , DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')) as expire_date, cbc.charge_type FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc ON cbc.charge_code = cbpd.charge_code WHERE user_code = #{value} ORDER BY start_date) fv_tb) sv_tb) result_tb

SELECT FORMAT(IFNULL(SUM(ORDER_PRICE), 0), 0) AS ORDER_PRICE FROM( SELECT ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_SALES FORCE INDEX(idx_interpark_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_1}) AND PAID_AT >= #{fromDate} AND PAID_AT < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_SALES FORCE INDEX(idx_gmarket_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_2}) AND PAID_AT >= #{fromDate} AND PAID_AT < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_SALES FORCE INDEX(idx_auction_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_3}) AND PAID_AT >= #{fromDate} AND PAID_AT < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT 판매금액합계 AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_11ST_SALEACCNT FORCE INDEX(idx_eleven_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_4}) AND 주문상태 NOT IN ('구매확정후주문취소','반품완료','취소처리중','클레임진행중') AND 결제완료일 >= DATE_FORMAT(#{fromDate}, '%Y/%m/%d') AND 결제완료일 < DATE_FORMAT(#{toDate}, '%Y/%m/%d') UNION ALL SELECT order_price AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_SALES FORCE INDEX(idx_coupang_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_11}) AND paid_at >= #{fromDate} AND paid_at < #{toDate} AND status IN ('ACCEPT','DELIVERING','DEPARTURE','FINAL_DELIVERY','INSTRUCT','NONE_TRACKING') AND sale_type IN ('', 'SALE') UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_NAVER_SALES FORCE INDEX(idx_naver_sales) WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_14}) AND PAID_AT >= #{fromDate} AND PAID_AT < #{toDate} AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('발송대기', '배송중', '배송완료', '빠른정산', '구매확정', '정산', '일반정산')) result_tb

SELECT FORMAT(IFNULL(sum(final_amount), 0), 0) as total_amount FROM( SELECT 정산확정금액 as final_amount FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_WITHDRAW_VALUE WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_1}) AND 정산확정일 >= DATE_FORMAT(#{fromDate}, '%Y.%m.%d') AND 정산확정일 < DATE_FORMAT(#{toDate}, '%Y.%m.%d') UNION ALL SELECT 송금액 as final_amount FROM CBCI_GMARKET_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_2}) AND 송금일 >= #{fromDate} AND 송금일 < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT 송금액 as final_amount FROM CBCI_AUCTION_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_3}) AND 송금일 >= #{fromDate} AND 송금일 < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT 송금액 as final_amount FROM CBCI_11ST_WITHDRAW WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_4}) AND 송금일자 >= DATE_FORMAT(#{fromDate}, '%Y/%m/%d') AND 송금일자 < DATE_FORMAT(#{toDate}, '%Y/%m/%d') UNION ALL SELECT final_amount as final_amount FROM CBCI_COUPANG_SETTLEMENT WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_11}) AND settlement_date >= #{fromDate} AND settlement_date < #{toDate} UNION ALL SELECT 정산금액 as final_amount FROM CBCI_NAVER_WITHDRAWDAY WHERE SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_14}) AND 정산완료일 >= DATE_FORMAT(#{fromDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND 정산완료일 < DATE_FORMAT(#{toDate}, '%Y%m%d')) result_tb

SELECT FORMAT(COUNT(DISTINCT MATCHING_CODE) + COUNT(IF(ISNULL(MATCHING_CODE), 1, NULL)), 0) AS TOTAL_SKU FROM( SELECT CIG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_1}) AND CIG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CIS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS WHERE CIS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_1}) UNION ALL SELECT CGG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_GOODS CGG WHERE CGG.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_2}) AND CGG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CGS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_STOCK CGS WHERE CGS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_2}) UNION ALL SELECT CAG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_3}) AND CAG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CAS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_STOCK CAS WHERE CAS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_3}) UNION ALL SELECT CSG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_4}) AND CSG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CSS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_11ST_STOCK CSS WHERE CSS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_4}) UNION ALL SELECT CCS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_11}) AND CCS.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CNG.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_14}) AND CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CNS.MATCHING_CODE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID IN (${SHOP_14})) result_tb
SELECT detail, object_no FROM CBCI_EVALUATE WHERE object_no = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_EVALUATE( division, object_no, reviewer, detail, input_date )VALUES( '00', #{code}, #{reviewer}, #{detail}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_EVALUATE SET detail = #{detail}, update_date = now() WHERE object_no = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @RNUM := @RNUM + 1 AS rnum, DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.payment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as payment_date, cbc.charge_name, DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(cbpd.cancel_date, IFNULL(cbpd.change_date, cbpd.expire_date)),'%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, FORMAT(cbc.amount * cbc.sub_period, 0) as amount, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(cbpd.cancel_date, cbpd.change_date),'%Y-%m-%d') as change_date, cbpd.promotion_code, IFNULL((SELECT promo_name FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc WHERE cbpd.promotion_code = cpc.promo_code),'') as promo_name, IFNULL(ABS(cbr.refund_amount),'') as refund_amount FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc on cbpd.charge_code = cbc.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_REFUND cbr on cbpd.seq = cbr.seq, (SELECT @RNUM := 0) RNUM WHERE cbpd.user_code = #{user_code} ORDER BY cbpd.payment_date ) RESULT_TB LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , cu.USER_CODE , CASE WHEN(mur.mb_status IN ('00', '01', '02', '03')) THEN '신청' WHEN(mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05')) THEN '심사' WHEN(mur.mb_status IN ('06')) THEN '상환' WHEN(mur.mb_status IN ('07')) THEN '만료' WHEN(mur.mb_status IN('41')) THEN '거부' END AS mb_status , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_request_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS mb_request_date , cu.USER_ID , cu.FIRM_NM , cu.USER_NM , mur.mbid , CASE WHEN(mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' END AS mb_product_code , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date,'%Y-%m-%d'), '-') AS mb_contract_date , IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date,'%Y-%m-%d'), '-') AS mb_contract_expire_date , IFNULL(mm.fee_rate, '0.8') as usage_fee , IF(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount IS NOT NULL, FORMAT(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount, 0), '-') AS calculate_deposit_amount , IF(mrc.act_principal IS NOT NULL, FORMAT(mrc.act_principal, 0), '-') AS act_principal , IF(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount - mrc.act_principal IS NOT NULL, FORMAT(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount - mrc.act_principal, 0), '-') AS repayment_balance , '-' AS PRIZM_SCORE FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp ON mur.mbid = mrp.mbid LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc ON mur.mbid = mrc.mbid LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid , (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE mur.mb_status IN (${status}) AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.USER_ID) LIKE UPPER('${userIdSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_request_date <= #{toDate} GROUP BY mur.mbid ) RESULT_TB ORDER BY mb_request_date ${selectOrderBy} LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(mur.mbid) as usageListTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('00', '01', '02', '03') THEN 1 END) AS acceptCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('04', '05') THEN 1 END) AS judgeCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('41') THEN 1 END) AS rejectCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('06') THEN 1 END) AS repaymentCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN mur.mb_status IN ('07') THEN 1 END) AS expireCnt FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE WHERE mur.mb_status IN (${status}) AND UPPER(cu.USER_NM) LIKE UPPER('${userNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.FIRM_NM) LIKE UPPER('${firmNmSearch}%') AND UPPER(cu.USER_ID) LIKE UPPER('${userIdSearch}%') AND UPPER(mur.mb_product_code) LIKE UPPER('${selectDivSearch}%') AND mur.mb_request_date >= #{fromDate} AND mur.mb_request_date < #{toDate}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(mb_request_date), '%y-%m-%d') AS mb_first_reg_date FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE user_code = #{user_code}

SELECT CASE WHEN (mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE '' END AS mb_product_code , mbid , DATE_FORMAT(mb_request_date,'%y-%m-%d') AS mb_request_date , DATE_FORMAT(mb_contract_date,'%y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_date , DATE_FORMAT(mb_contract_expire_date,'%y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_expire_date , '-' AS PCS , '-' AS PCM FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST WHERE user_code = #{user_code} ORDER BY mb_request_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT RESULT_TB2.* FROM ( SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT mur.mbid AS mbid , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date,'%y-%m-%d') AS mb_contract_date , CASE WHEN (mur.mb_product_code = 'MP') THEN '머니플러스' ELSE '' END AS mb_product_code , IF(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount IS NOT NULL, FORMAT(SUM(mrp.calculate_deposit_amount), 0), '-') AS calculate_deposit_amount , IF(mur.mb_termi_date IS NULL, DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date ,'%y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_termi_date ,'%y-%m-%d')) AS mb_contract_expire_date , IFNULL(mm.fee_rate, '0.8') AS fee_rate , IF(mur.mb_termi_date IS NULL, DATEDIFF(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, mur.mb_contract_date), DATEDIFF(mur.mb_termi_date, mur.mb_contract_date)) AS service_day , '-' AS PCS , '-' AS PCM FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc ON mur.mbid = mrc.mbid LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_REDEM_PROVISION mrp ON mur.mbid = mrp.mbid LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_MONEYPLUS mm ON mur.mbid = mm.mbid WHERE mur.user_code = #{user_code} AND (mur.mb_contract_expire_date < NOW() OR mur.mb_termi_date IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY mur.mbid ORDER BY mur.mb_contract_date DESC ) RESULT_TB, (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB ) RESULT_TB2 LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT IF(msc.biz_no IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS biz_no_chk , IF(mur.reg_no_first IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS reg_no_chk , msc.national_tax_full_payment AS national_tax_chk , msc.local_tax_full_payment AS local_tax_chk , msc.health_insurance_full_payment AS health_insurance_chk FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN MONEYBANK_SUB_CHECK msc ON mur.mbid = msc.mbid WHERE mur.mbid = #{mbid}
